description: List ViralHunt content templates (layouts you fill and render yourself). Lean by design — no html/css — so use viralhunt_get_template for the one you'll actually render.

assigned.description: true = only the templates assigned to project_id.

favorites.description: true = only the templates the brand starred. Favourites come first in every list: prefer them when several fit.

media_type.description: Filter by what it renders to.

network.description: Only templates suited to this network.

project_id.description: With assigned=true, the project whose allowed templates you want.

name: viralhunt_list_templates
